findings.location: HTML, poem stanza beginning “While we thank God for freedom here”
findings.source_quote: “While we thank God for freedom here, / They praise their Lord on high. / And thank Him that for Jesus’ sake / They suffer and they die.”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the final two lines so they retain the subject “they,” for example: “En dank Hom dat hulle ter wille van Jesus / ly en sterf.”
findings.translation_quote: “Terwyl ons God dank vir vryheid hier, / Prys hulle hul Here in die hoogte. / En dank hulle Hom dat hulle ter wille van Jesus / Ly en sterf.”

findings.location: HTML, poem stanza beginning “In other lands this very day”
findings.source_quote: “In other lands this very day, / The fire is burning bright;”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a natural Afrikaans rendering of “this very day,” such as “Juis vandag brand die vuur in ander lande helder.”
findings.translation_quote: “In ander lande brand die vuur / Juis vandag helder;”
